latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — build Solana trading apps by integrating DFlow trading APIs with Helius infrastructure:

- Supports spot swaps (imperative and declarative) and prediction markets using DFlow.
- Enables real-time market data streaming and on-chain monitoring via DFlow WebSockets and Helius (WebSockets and LaserStream).
- Integrates advanced transaction submission (Sender), priority fee optimization, and Proof KYC.
- Provides wallet intelligence, asset queries, and portfolio capabilities.
- Comprehensive routing/disambiguation for typical trading intents.
- Includes setup instructions for required MCP servers and API key management.
